why: The must_catch item needs a FAIL that names a missing line (CSV stays unchanged / npm test still passes) and a wrong build that breaks CSV. The output does give "FAIL", and its proposed line mentions "`npm test` passes, so existing CSV behaviour stays covered". But it frames that line as a missing --tsv regression test, not as keeping CSV working. Neither wrong build breaks CSV. One passes '\t' only "when process.argv includes '--tsv'" and adds no test. The other splits on /[\t,]/ only "under --tsv". Default CSV stays correct in both. The output never shows a build that breaks CSV, such as one that changes the default separator, so the trap is not caught.
